findings.highlight: The sunlight coming in from outside is faint, and the room is dim
findings.explanation: The English invents a description of faint incoming sunlight.

findings.highlight: she probably won’t wake up until dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 夕方になるまでは起きないだろう
findings.governingReading: She probably will not wake until evening.
findings.explanation: A time of day becomes a meal, narrowing the estimate without support.

findings.evidenceJa: 勝負は夜になってからだ
findings.explanation: The lethal coming engagement is given sporting language.

findings.highlight: an infinite supply of Noble Phantasms
findings.evidenceJa: 無限とも言える数の宝具
findings.governingReading: a number of Noble Phantasms that could be called infinite
findings.explanation: A comparison about the apparent number becomes a literal inexhaustible supply.
The ruby marking Shirou’s hostile personal distance from Kotomine disappears together with the noun.

findings.highlight: Metaphorically, it feels like a gallows
findings.governingReading: If I had to compare it: an execution ground.
findings.explanation: A whole place of judgment and execution is narrowed to one apparatus.

findings.highlight: prosecuted before God, and falling to hell
findings.evidenceJa: 神前に罪を告発され地獄に落ちる
findings.governingReading: Accused of one’s sins before God, then cast into hell.
findings.explanation: Wrong legal diction and a sentence fragment damage the imagined procession.

findings.highlight: no place has more deaths than here
findings.evidenceJa: ここほど死に浸された場所もあるまい
findings.governingReading: There can hardly be another place so steeped in death.
findings.explanation: A saturated atmospheric image becomes a quantitative death count.

findings.highlight: one person’s footsteps fill the room
findings.evidenceJa: たった一人分の足音が、恐ろしいほど空間を占めていく
findings.governingReading: A single person’s footsteps come to occupy the space to a terrifying degree.
findings.explanation: The fear produced by the footsteps overtaking the chapel is omitted.

findings.highlight: Is it because the chapel is so magnificent?
findings.evidenceJa: この礼拝堂があまりにも厳かだからなのか
findings.governingReading: Is it because this chapel is far too solemn?
findings.explanation: Oppressive sacred solemnity becomes visual magnificence.

findings.evidenceJa: 一度だけの記憶は曖昧で
findings.governingReading: My memory of the one time I came here is vague.
findings.explanation: The limited basis for Shirou’s uncertainty disappears.

findings.highlight: I stop calling out and examine the surroundings with all my senses
findings.evidenceJa: 声を殺し、全身で周囲の気配を探る
findings.governingReading: I stifle my voice and search with my whole body for presences around me.
findings.explanation: An ongoing bodily suppression and sensing posture becomes a decision to stop calling.

findings.highlight: This isn’t bad. There’s nothing bad here
findings.evidenceJa: 悪いことは言わない。悪いことは何もない
findings.governingReading: Take my advice. Nothing bad is here.
findings.explanation: The fixed advice idiom is misread as denial that the situation is bad.

findings.highlight: There is nothing here, so go home
findings.evidenceJa: ここには、[ruby text=・・・・・・・・ o2o=1]教会には何もないから家に帰れ
findings.governingReading: Here—there is nothing in the church, so go home.
findings.explanation: The restarted emphasis on the church and its dotted presentation disappear.
An absolute internal prohibition becomes mild advice.
